messages:
Aisha: Heads-up: daylight kernel+quant cutover today 11:30 PT. Need smoke, canary slice, rollback playbook.

deploybot: auto: scheduling pin runtime-engine@v3.0.2-qk-20260321 -> region-us-west-2. initial TTL=6h.

Tom: small canary 3/60. last tweak caused kv-prefetch noise.

Nikhil: Smoke gates: p50/p95, inference.errors.rate, kv-prefetch-rate. Abort if p95 > baseline+50ms or errors >1% for 2m.

Rae: Watch mem pressure. If worker RSS +20% for 3m, capture heap and rollback. Cmd: capture_heap --pid $(pgrep runtime-engine) --out /tmp/heap-<ts>.dmp

Aisha: Draft release note: "runtime-engine v3.0.2-qk: quant updates + matmul micro-kernel; daylight canary."

deploybot: canary started -> slice 3/60. telemetry: https://telemetry.company/canary/3648309999

Tom: local smoke: ./smoke.sh --engine runtime-engine@v3.0.2-qk-20260321 --checks p50,p95,kv_prefetch,mem --duration 6m -> p50 +4ms, p95 +22ms, mem steady.

Nikhil: tightened alert quant-daylight-kv-spike to 2m window. Fire -> unpin.

Aisha: change pin TTL to 24h after canary stable so it doesn't auto-clear mid-investigation.

Rae: +1. Manual unpin only from ops channel.

deploybot: pin updated by Aisha -> TTL=24h.

deploybot: canary update @+10m: steady. p50 +5ms, p95 +18ms, errors 0.3%, kv-prefetch +35% expected.

Tom: will watch 10m then ramp to 25%.

Nikhil: Rollback steps (automated): 1) unpin -> runtime-engine@v3.0.1-stable 2) drain slices 3) tag build qk-20260321-failed 4) open postmortem stub. Manual: oncall confirm.

Aisha: Capture checklist: stack traces, heap dump, L3 occupancy, matmul perf counters -> artifacts at /artifacts/eng-runtime/3648309999.

oncall: noted, available during window.

Rae: Keep eval harness ready for long-context quality diffs: https://ci.company/evals/quant-daylight/20260321

deploybot: scheduled ramp to 25% in +15m unless abort. final: pinned runtime-engine@v3.0.2-qk-20260321 TTL=24h; canary stable."
